name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window replays a short session when it scrolls into view: each command types itself after the prompt, its output appears at once, then the next command starts.

meta.reducedMotion: The whole session is shown at once.
meta.useWhen: The product really is used from a command line (a CLI, a dev tool, an install step), and the session shown is real and copy-pasteable.
meta.avoidWhen: As "techy" decoration for a product with no CLI; sessions longer than about 8 lines; fake output.
